subject: Expedited decision requested: in-country data lock & audit window for pilot
messages:
From: Alice Bryan <alice@bluemesa.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot: in-country data lock & limited audit window

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're eager to get a short pilot going, but a couple of non-standard constraints surfaced from our security/compliance review that we'd need Redwood to accept for the pilot to proceed: 

- Data residency: all patient content must remain within the US and be stored in BlueMesa's dedicated VPC (no shared-hosted storage).
- Audit access: we will need a yearly audit window with read-only access to operational logs for a 3-business-day period (no continuous access).
- No external egress of raw logs or training data unless explicitly authorized.
- KMS-backed key management (customer-managed keys / HSM) for encryption at rest.

We know these are somewhat atypical for a pilot. Two asks: can Redwood confirm if these are feasible for a 90-day pilot, and whether you can approve an introductory commercial concession (we're asking for a 25% pilot discount to offset integration cost)?

I've attached a short SOW and the security questionnaire we completed. We're on a tight timeline — the exec team would like a decision this week so we can start in late September.

Best,
Alice
Director, Security & Compliance
BlueMesa Health

Attachments:
- BlueMesa_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW stub)
- Security_Questionnaire_2026.xlsx (completed questionnaire)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Bryan <alice@bluemesa.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: in-country data lock & limited audit window

Hi Alice — thank you, and great to hear the demo landed well.

Short answers up front: we can probably support these constraints for a timeboxed pilot, but I need Deal Desk and Sales Ops to sign off on the commercial concession and the exact operational guardrails. Looping Marissa and Jordan so we can fast-track an internal decision.

Proposed next steps:
- I will escalate to Deal Desk now with the ask below (copying critical constraints and the requested 25% introductory discount).
- Marissa/Jordan: can you confirm equity between the pilot economics and the operational burden? If approved, I'll ask Legal to bake the limited audit window + read-only scope into the SOW.
- Alice: one clarification — is the KMS requirement customer-managed KMS (BYOK) or do you accept Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys under a contractual guarantee? Please advise.

I understand the timeline is compressed; we will prioritize.

Thanks,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: BlueMesa pilot — decision requested this week

Team — escalating for formal approval. Key asks from the customer (BlueMesa Health):

- Private/VPC hosting only (customer VPC in us-central or equivalent), no multi-tenant storage.
- Customer-managed keys preferred; if not possible, HSM-backed Redwood-managed KMS with contractual protections.
- Audit: 3 business days per year read-only access to operational logs, with 2 weeks' notice. Access must be timeboxed and forensics-only; no copying of raw PII outside the VPC.
- No egress of raw logs or training data without explicit written permission.
- Commercial: 90-day pilot, asking for 25% pilot discount against list prices; 12-month commit post-pilot is preferred by the customer.

Impact notes:
- Engineering: provisioning a dedicated VPC and enabling BYOK/HSM will require a small staging window and a runbook; estimated infra OPs time ~ 3–5 days to validate.
- Risk/Legal: the audit window scope will need narrow scoping language (read-only, redaction requirements).
- Finance: 25% is a material concession for a pilot; would like Deal Desk guidance.

Request: Marissa/Jordan — please confirm:
1) commercial concession approved (yes/no, and % if different),
2) operational constraints acceptable, and
3) any further risk conditions (e.g., SOC2 evidence, additional indemnities) to require from BlueMesa before we flip the switch.

I attached the BlueMesa SOW + security questionnaire for context. Their requested timeline: decision by 2026-09-11 EOD.

Thanks,
Rachel

Attachments:
- BlueMesa_SOW_draft.pdf
- Security_Questionnaire_2026.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: BlueMesa pilot — decision requested this week

Rachel — thanks for the clear summary. Endorsing the pilot but with a narrower commercial ask given precedent and operational lift. My position:

- Discount: 15% pilot discount (instead of 25%). Pilot is 90 days; if BlueMesa converts to a 12-month committed purchase within 60 days of pilot completion we can provide a retroactive credit to reach 20% (conditional).
- Audit window: limit to 48 hours (2 business days) for the pilot, with an option to extend to 3 business days for full production under contract. The 48-hour limitation reduces the operational risk for limited-time pilots.
- KMS: prefer Redwood-managed HSM-backed KMS for the pilot; offer a migration path to customer-managed KMS for production. Engineering has concerns about BYOK for a short pilot.
- Must require SOC2 Type II evidence and a signed DPA that prohibits data export of PII.

I attached a short deal-summary that shows the revenue impact of the different discount tiers. If Jordan approves a middle ground, I'm comfortable moving Legal to draft the SOW with the limited audit scope and redaction rules.

Marissa
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- deal-summary.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, LegalOps <legalops@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: BlueMesa pilot — decision requested this week

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. I am authorizing a conditional concession to enable the pilot while protecting Redwood's risk posture. My decision: 

- Commercial: approve a 20% pilot discount (compromise between asks). Provide a retroactive uplift to 25% only if BlueMesa signs a 12-month commitment within 45 days after pilot close.
- Audit: approve a 3 business-day annual audit window for production; for the 90-day pilot limit to 3 business days but require 2 weeks' advance notice and a narrow written scope (read-only operational logs, redaction of PII, no data copying off the VPC). LegalOps, please add explicit language that prohibits export of raw patient data without executive-level sign-off.
- KMS: allow Redwood-managed HSM-backed KMS for pilot. Require a migration plan to customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production.
- Preconditions before provisioning: receipt of signed DPA, SOC2 Type II evidence, and a completed security attestation from BlueMesa (already received).

Rachel/Marissa — please have LegalOps prepare a short SOW amendment that captures these points and include a rollback/fallback clause to host fallback if we cannot get required agreements in place. Once LegalOps confirms wording, Rachel you may confirm to the customer and schedule provisioning.

Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
